body.statement: The six response types outside \(\{000,111\}\) have \((\mu(t),\nu(t),\mu(t)^2)\) equal to \((-1/2,-1,1/4)\), \((-1/2,1,1/4)\), \((-1,0,1)\), \((1,0,1)\), \((1/2,-1,1/4)\), and \((1/2,1,1/4)\). Consequently the tangent program has the exact value \[V(\theta,\eta)=\max\{|\theta|/2,|\eta|/4\}.\] Integer response-type counts recover every compact set of local coordinates with \(O(n^{-2/3})\) coordinate and cost error.
body.justification: The polyhedral potential is the first mathematical step that differs from the published scalar two-arm boundary.
body.gap: The two-arm potential in Sudijono, Dobriban, and Tchetgen Tchetgen (2026, Section 3) is \(|\theta|\); no cited work derives this labelled face/corner support function.
body.consumer: The explicit potential identifies which complete schedules drive second-order risk and makes the proposed constant numerically and analytically evaluable.
